vc_checking.summary: All seven target manual VCs are semantically proofable under the current annotation and case-lib seed. The implementation entailment covers exactly the member-tail/member-nontail and sentinel-empty/sentinel-nonempty cases. The four return VCs can rebuild the circular DLL after the pointer updates, selecting the full-DLL side of each generated Coq disjunction. The two public-contract derivations specialize dispatch to the sentinel or member case and discharge the separating implication by identity after simplifying dispatch semantics. No annotation/spec repair is indicated. Two pure list helpers are likely useful for the implementation entailment; spatial splitting/reassembly and sentinel-not-in-nodes can be proved locally from the current xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg definitions.

natural_language_analysis.summary: The five implementation witnesses form one DLL split/reassembly family and fit within the controller bound. The two derived public contracts use a distinct existential-plus-wand specialization pattern, so they form a second group.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Split anchor admissibility. For In anchor nodes, obtain nodes = prefix ++ anchor :: suffix with anchor absent from prefix, split the DLL segment at anchor, then destruct suffix into nil or old_next :: rest. For anchor = head, open xizi_dll and destruct nodes into nil or old_next :: rest. These four cases instantiate the four generated disjuncts in their displayed order.
witnesses.space_plan: Use xizi_dll_open. In the member case, inductively split xizi_dllseg at the first occurrence to expose prefix segment, anchor links, and suffix segment. In the sentinel nonempty case unfold the first dllseg cell; in the sentinel empty case reduce the empty segment to first = last = head. Preserve the local-variable cell and standalone inserted node unchanged.
witnesses.pure_plan: From xizi_dll derive head <> 0 and head not in nodes; hence a member anchor is distinct from head. The first-occurrence list helper supplies prefix/suffix and ~In anchor prefix. Unfold dispatch_nodes: anchor = head gives inserted :: nodes; anchor <> head reduces to insert_after_nodes, whose first-occurrence helper gives prefix ++ anchor :: inserted :: suffix. Suffix destruct supplies nil/cons facts and old_next <> 0 follows from the nonempty segment.
witnesses.refinement_plan: Not a safeExec/refinement VC; the four disjuncts are a shape-and-pure dispatch split.
